rows: source contact sheet reading order (left-to-right, then next row)
views: inferred orthographic; not recovered pixels; not calibrated 3D
prompt: Produce a transparent RGBA atlas with exactly 6 equal object rows and 6 equal direction columns. The input is a 3-column by 2-row source contact sheet; read rows left-to-right, then next row. Put these six objects as atlas rows in that order. Columns are exactly front, top, right, left, bottom, rear. Keep one inferred orthographic drawing centered in each cell, consistent object scale across its six views. Preserve each source identity, palette, material, markings and all geometry. Axis-aligned cameras only, zero perspective or rotation; no extra objects, text, labels, grid, borders, background shadows, or cell overlap. For walls/doors/stairs, show true front/rear faces and narrow edge-on side views; top/bottom are plan views with full footprint. Every view is inferred, not recovered pixels.
